tools.description: Move the pointer to physical desktop coordinates using the provider-owned native backend

tools.description: Click a mouse button at the current pointer position using the provider-owned native backend

tools.short_description: Click a mouse button at the current position

tools.description: Type raw text into the focused application using the provider-owned native backend

parameters.name: text

tools.short_description: Type supplied text into the focused application

tools.description: Tap a key or plus-separated key combination using the provider-owned native backend

parameters.name: keys
